newsitem.title: USA: Tropical Storm Isidore no threat to land for days.
newsitem.headline: Tropical Storm Isidore no threat to land for days.

text.p: Tropical Storm Isidore swiftly gained strength in the mid-Atlantic on Wednesday and could become a hurricane within 24 hours, the National Hurricane Center said.

Isidore graduated to tropical storm status early on Wednesday, becoming the ninth tropical storm of the Atlantic hurricane season. Its maximum sustained winds were 65 mph (105 kph), nearing the threshold of 74 mph (120 kph) at which a tropical storm becomes a hurricane.
At its current speed and position, Isidore would not approach the Caribbean for four to five days, forecasters said.
At 5 p.m. EDT (2100 GMT), the center of Isidore was located at latitude 11.1 north and longitude 32.3 west, about 600 miles (950 km) west-southwest of Cape Verde Islands.
The storm was moving west-northwest at 16 mph (26 kph) and that motion was expected to continue, forecasters said.
